/* Shop profile redesign: visual layer only; PHP data, links, counters, and forms stay unchanged. */
body {
  background: #f5f8f6;
  color: #122f31;
}

.o2o-shop-hero {
  background: #102f33;
  border: 0 !important;
  height: 330px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.o2o-shop-hero::after {
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(16, 47, 51, 0.82), rgba(16, 47, 51, 0.32) 54%, rgba(16, 47, 51, 0.72)),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16, 47, 51, 0.02), rgba(16, 47, 51, 0.84));
  content: '';
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  position: absolute;
}

.o2o-shop-cover-img {
  cursor: pointer;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  width: 100%;
}

.o2o-shop-cover-img:hover {
  transform: scale(1.015);
}

.o2o-shop-hero-content {
  bottom: 34px;
  color: #ffffff;
  left: calc(min(7vw, 82px) + 180px);
  max-width: 620px;
  position: absolute;
  right: 210px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.o2o-shop-hero-kicker {
  align-items: center;
  background: rgba(248, 193, 74, 0.16);
  border: 1px solid rgba(248, 193, 74, 0.38);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #ffe28b;
  display: inline-flex;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 900;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  padding: 6px 11px;
}

.o2o-shop-hero-title {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 34px;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.08;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
}

.o2o-shop-hero-location {
  align-items: center;
  color: #d8f2e9;
  display: flex;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  gap: 6px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.o2o-shop-avatar {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 6px solid #ffffff;
  border-radius: 24px;
  bottom: 32px;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
  cursor: pointer;
  height: 154px;
  left: min(7vw, 82px);
  overflow: visible;
  position: absolute;
  transition: transform 0.18s ease;
  width: 154px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.o2o-shop-avatar:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.o2o-shop-avatar > img:not(.mobile-verified) {
  border-radius: 18px;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
}

.o2o-shop-avatar .mobile-verified {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 3px solid #ffffff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
  height: 30px !important;
  object-fit: contain;
  position: absolute !important;
  right: -12px !important;
  top: -12px !important;
  width: 30px !important;
  z-index: 4;
}

.o2o-shop-like-panel,
.o2o-shop-views {
  position: absolute;
  right: 18px;
  text-align: center;
  z-index: 2;
}

.o2o-shop-like-panel {
  align-items: flex-end;
  bottom: 28px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.o2o-shop-views {
  align-items: center;
  background: rgba(16, 47, 51, 0.78);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #ffffff;
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 13px;
  top: 20px;
}

.o2o-shop-like-panel .btn {

  border-color: #f8c14a;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #102f33;
  font-weight: 900;
}

  font-size: 0.95rem !important;
  padding: 8px 12px;

  justify-content: flex-end;

  padding: 12px 26px;

.o2o-shop-owner-bar .btn {

	function getParsedUrl(href) {

		parser.href = href;
		return parser;
	}

	function isSameSiteUrl(parsedUrl) {
		return parsedUrl.protocol === window.location.protocol && parsedUrl.host === window.location.host;
	}

	function findClosestLink(target) {
		while (target && target !== document) {
			if (target.tagName === 'A' && target.getAttribute('href')) {
				return target;
			}

			target = target.parentNode;
		}

		return null;
	}

	function shouldSkipLinkLoader(link, event) {
		var href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
		var target = (link.getAttribute('target') || '').toLowerCase();
		var parsedUrl;

		if (event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) {
			return true;
		}

		if (!href || href.charAt(0) === '#' || href.toLowerCase().indexOf('javascript:') === 0 || externalProtocols.test(href)) {

		}

			return true;
		}

		if (link.hasAttribute('download') || link.getAttribute('data-no-loader') === 'true') {
			return true;
		}

		parsedUrl = getParsedUrl(href);

		if (!isSameSiteUrl(parsedUrl) || downloadPattern.test(parsedUrl.pathname)) {
			return true;
		}

		if (parsedUrl.pathname === window.location.pathname && parsedUrl.search === window.location.search && parsedUrl.hash) {
			return true;
		}

		return false;
	}

		var parsedUrl = getParsedUrl(action);

		if (event.defaultPrevented || form.getAttribute('data-no-loader') === 'true') {
			return true;
		}

		if (target && target !== '_self') {
			return true;
		}

		return !isSameSiteUrl(parsedUrl);
	}

	document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
		var link = findClosestLink(event.target);

		if (!link || shouldSkipLinkLoader(link, event)) {
			return;
		}
